trace.notes: Resolved the zbMATH URL to a bibliographic HTML page for Zbl 0525.05019. The visible page exposes citation metadata, a review summary, and a review-PDF action, but not the article body or any explicit open-problem statements from the underlying paper.

No extractable open-problem statements were present in the chosen source text. The page only summarized the paper at a bibliographic level and did not expose the underlying problem list or survey text.

Failed the source-adequacy gate because the resolver page did not provide readable full-text problem statements for the exact work, and resolver-metadata follow-up did not recover a readable exact-work copy from the consulted Crossref/OpenAlex lookups.
